coordinates: GLB x=author x, y=height, z=-author y, metres
selection_policy: Independent reviewer selects alternate facade pane/solid points, actual exposed terrace points and front voids from documented estimated planes. Actual indexed triangle intersections alone determine results. The probes test the authored exterior, not measured physical dimensions.

rays.label: garden-wide-window
rays.selection_note: Independent middle-bay pane point at an alternate height on the folded garden facade.

rays.label: garden-wall-positive-control
rays.selection_note: Masonry between two broad windows; solid control adjacent to the previous hole probe.

rays.label: central-narrow-window
rays.selection_note: Narrow central tower column, away from mullion and continuous pale fin.

rays.label: central-continuous-fin-positive-control
rays.selection_note: A real pale fin between narrow columns; offset avoids the full-only fine rib.

rays.label: outer-wing-narrow-window
rays.selection_note: Outer pale-accent wing window instead of repeating the central garden facade test.

rays.label: rear-estimated-window
rays.selection_note: Tests actual closure/opening geometry only; rear appearance is explicitly unverified by the photographs.
